verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a public Skills API. You can upload and manage skills through it, with a Skill Versions API for version management. Skills are invoked programmatically via the Messages API `container` parameter (`skill_id`, `type`, optional `version`, up to 20 per request), and the Agent SDK lets code control which skills sessions can invoke, dispatch commands by name, and load plugins. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on evidence of the Skills API in use, and only thin endpoint-level detail (create/list/delete operations are linked rather than described).
